using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef vector<int> vi;
typedef vector<ll> vll;
typedef vector<vi> vvi;
typedef vector<vll> vvll;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
typedef pair<ll, ll> pll;

class Modulo {
private:
    const ll mod;

public:
    Modulo(ll mod) : mod(mod) {}

    ll plus(ll a, ll b) const {
        ll c = a + b;
        if (c >= mod) c -= mod;
        return c;
    }

    ll minus(ll a, ll b) const {
        ll c = a - b;
        if (c < 0) c += mod;
        return c;
    }

    ll times(ll a, ll b) const { return (a * b) % mod; }

    ll div(ll a, ll b) const { return times(a, pow(b, mod - 2)); }

    ll pow(ll a, ll b) const {
        ll c = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) > 0) c = (c * a) % mod;
            a = (a * a) % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return c;
    }

    ll combination(int n, int k) const {
        return div(factorial(n), times(factorial(k), factorial(n - k)));
    }

    ll combination(int n, int k, const vector<ll>& factorials) const {
        return div(factorials[n], times(factorials[k], factorials[n - k]));
    }

    ll factorial(int n) const {
        ll f = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) f = (f * i) % mod;
        return f;
    }

    vector<ll> factorials(int n) const {
        vector<ll> f(n + 1);
        f[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) f[i] = (f[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        return f;
    }
};

class FastReader {
private:
    istream& is;
    string buffer;
    size_t pos;

public:
    FastReader(istream& is = cin) : is(is), pos(0) {}

    string next() {
        while (true) {
            if (buffer.empty() || pos >= buffer.size()) {
                if (!getline(is, buffer)) return "";
                pos = 0;
            }
            while (pos < buffer.size() && isspace(buffer[pos])) pos++;
            if (pos >= buffer.size()) {
                buffer.clear();
                continue;
            }
            size_t start = pos;
            while (pos < buffer.size() && !isspace(buffer[pos])) pos++;
            return buffer.substr(start, pos - start);
        }
    }

    int nextInt() { return stoi(next()); }
    ll nextLong() { return stoll(next()); }
};

class FastWriter : public ostream {
private:
    ostream& os;
    string buffer;
    static const size_t BUFFER_SIZE = 1 << 20;

public:
    FastWriter(ostream& os = cout) : os(os) {
        buffer.reserve(BUFFER_SIZE);
    }

    ~FastWriter() {
        flush();
    }

    void flush() {
        os << buffer;
        os.flush();
        buffer.clear();
    }

    template<typename T>
    FastWriter& operator<<(const T& val) {
        string s = to_string(val);
        if (buffer.size() + s.size() > BUFFER_SIZE) {
            os << buffer;
            buffer.clear();
        }
        buffer += s;
        return *this;
    }

    FastWriter& operator<<(char c) {
        if (buffer.size() + 1 > BUFFER_SIZE) {
            os << buffer;
            buffer.clear();
        }
        buffer += c;
        return *this;
    }

    FastWriter& operator<<(const string& s) {
        if (buffer.size() + s.size() > BUFFER_SIZE) {
            os << buffer;
            buffer.clear();
        }
        buffer += s;
        return *this;
    }

    template<typename T>
    void println(const T& val) {
        *this << val << '\n';
    }

    void println() { *this << '\n'; }
};

class MathUtils {
public:
    static const double EPS = 1e-12;
    
    static int compare(double x, double y) {
        if (x + EPS < y) return -1;
        else if (x - EPS > y) return 1;
        else return 0;
    }

    static int binarySearch(int left, int right, function<bool(int)> leftShouldAdvance) {
        while (left < right) {
            int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
            if (leftShouldAdvance(mid)) left = mid + 1;
            else right = mid;
        }
        return left;
    }

    static int lowerBound(const vi& a, int x) {
        return binarySearch(0, (int)a.size(), [&](int mid) { return a[mid] < x; });
    }
    static int lowerBound(const vll& a, long long x) {
        return binarySearch(0, (int)a.size(), [&](int mid) { return a[mid] < x; });
    }
    static int upperBound(const vi& a, int x) {
        return binarySearch(0, (int)a.size(), [&](int mid) { return a[mid] <= x; });
    }
    static int upperBound(const vll& a, long long x) {
        return binarySearch(0, (int)a.size(), [&](int mid) { return a[mid] <= x; });
    }

    static long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
        while (b > 0) {
            long long t = a % b;
            a = b;
            b = t;
        }
        return a;
    }

    static long long lcm(long long a, long long b) {
        return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
    }
};

class E {
private:
    FastReader in;
    FastWriter out;

public:
    E() : in(), out() {}

    void run() {
        int t = 1;
        while (t-- > 0) {
            solve();
        }
        out.flush();
    }

    void solve() {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        ll kt = in.nextLong();

        if (kt >= n) {
            out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        int k = (int)kt;
        Modulo mod(998244353);
        vector<ll> facts = mod.factorials(n);

        ll ans = 0;
        int c = n - k;
        for (int i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
            ll term = mod.times(mod.combination(c, i, facts), mod.pow(c - i, n));
            if (i % 2 == 0) {
                ans = mod.plus(ans, term);
            } else {
                ans = mod.minus(ans, term);
            }
        }
        ans = mod.times(ans, mod.combination(n, n - k, facts));

        if (k > 0) ans = mod.times(ans, 2);
        out.println(ans);
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    E solver;
    solver.run();
    
    return 0;
}
